chen_2020_tcells.design: The same RNA from each of 40 naive CD4+ T-cell donors was processed with TruSeq poly(A) selection and TruSeq Stranded Total RNA with Ribo-Zero Gold.

zhao_2018_blood_colon.design: The same pooled blood RNA and the same colon RNA were processed by both methods, with four technical libraries per method and tissue.
zhao_2018_blood_colon.limitation: Two biological source RNAs only; technical libraries are not independent biological pairs.

gse150097_candidate.reason: Both protocols are present, but the deposited sample-level records do not provide a complete authoritative same-RNA cross-protocol pair map; protocol is additionally confounded with read layout/read length/depth.

archs4.rule: total RNA alone is not proof of rRNA depletion
